title: Hub override skill resolution: WAI-Hub/skills/{id}/ checked before WAI-Spoke/skills/{id}/
event: Hub-node skill resolution order established — hub overrides take precedence over spoke base skills
what_changed: Before: No resolution protocol; hub skills lived in WAI-Spoke/skills/ alongside spoke skills. After: Hub checks WAI-Hub/skills/{id}/{command_file} first; falls back to WAI-Spoke/skills/{id}/{command_file}. Hub-enriched wakeup/closeout live in WAI-Hub/skills/, not WAI-Spoke/skills/.
why: Hub nodes run richer protocols than spokes. The override model lets the hub extend spoke skills without forking them. Spoke base skills remain portable and reusable.
